spans.s: लय् vt. 1Ā (pres. लयते) To go, to move.

लय m. 1. Adherence, union; 2. fusion, solution, absorption; 3. concentration, exclusive devotion, ध्यानलयेन पुरः परिकल्प्य भवंतमतीव दुरापम् Git.G.iv.; 4. destruction, disappearance; 5. an embrace; 6. rest, repose; 7. mental inactivity; 8. time (in music, किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः R.ix.35, पादन्यासो लयमुपगतः Mal.ii.; 9. habitation, residence, Sis.iv.57.
लय-आरंभ, -आलंभ m. an actor, a dancer.
लय-आरंभ, -आलंभ m. an actor, a dancer.
लय-काल m. the time of dissolution.
लय-पुत्री f. an actress, a female dancer.
लयन n. 1. Adhering, clinging; 2. rest, repose; 3. a house.
